vulnerability.name: CVE-2025-69872
vulnerability.description: DiskCache through 5.6.3 uses pickle serialization by default; an attacker with write access to the cache directory can execute code when an application reads the cache.

statements.status_notes: Scope: ansys-saf-glow-engine 2.6.dev0 package runtime. DiskCache is resolved only through the root workspace's tests-glow-engine development group via dash[diskcache], not through the Glow Engine package's runtime or optional dependencies; the current CycloneDX 1.5 package SBOM contains no diskcache component. The only repository code use is packages/glow-engine/tests/mocks/solution_end_to_end/ui/first_page.py, a test mock. That fixture is conditionally vulnerable if an attacker can write to ./cache and the test app reads that cache. This statement covers only the package runtime; it does not cover test/development executions, generated customer applications, or deployments that independently install DiskCache.
